questions.question:
In the following question below are given some ststatements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

Statements:

I. All trousers are white.

II. All white are colour.

Conclusions:

I. Some white are trousers.

II. All colour are white.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is shown below according to the given information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/296f2562dd5e1e3e5f5fa4d0ec4b07f0250f4e11a1125332bb837897455d3b39.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some white are trousers. - True (All Trouser are White. Some white are trousers. Some trousers are white. Hence, it is True)

II. All colour are white. - False (All white are colour.All colour are white is may be possible but not definite Hence, it is False)

Only conclusion (I) follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**

A person buys 10 articles at rate of Rs 5 each and 30 articles at the rae ot Rs 10 each. What will be the average price (in Rs) per article?
questions.solution:
Given,

A person buys 10 articles at rate of Rs. 5 each and 30 articles at the Rate of Rs. 10 each.

Total price of 10 Article = 10 × 5 = 50

And 30 articles at the Rate of Rs. 10 each.

Total price of 30 Article = 30 × 10 = 300

Average = 50 + 300/ 10 + 30

= 350/ 40

= 35/ 4

= 8.75

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**

questions.question: P can do a piece of work in 7 days and Q can do the same work in 21 days. How many days will both take together to complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Given,

 

P can do a piece of work in 7 days

Q can do the same work in 21 days

1/ P + 1/ Q = 1/ 7 + 1/ 21

= 3 + 1 /21

= 4/ 21

(P + Q) can complete the whole work = 21/ 4 days

= 5. 25

 

They can complete the same work in 5.25 days.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**

questions.question:
In the following question, select the missing number from the given series.

3, 7, 16, 32, 57,?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

3 + 2² = 7

7 + 3² = 16

16 + 4² = 32

32 + 5² = 57

57 + 6² = 93

Hence, the correct answer is ‘93’
